memory_candidates.content: For a manifest routing block with a different depth than the existing {op: {task_type: value}} shape (e.g. a one-level {task_type: [...]} block), write a full sibling ladder function (same 4-step non-core/core x exact/compound precedence, own doc comment) rather than reusing the existing two-level resolver with a fabricated key. This keeps the shape mismatch visible and prevents a future 'simplification' from silently corrupting resolution.

When a plan's audit/verification phase requires redeploying a source-store-backed deploy tree (e.g. .claude/ from agent-system/extensions/**) but the dispatching orchestrator has explicitly reserved the redeploy checkpoint for itself, close that phase [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a Reasoned Exclusions record rather than forcing the redeploy or leaving the phase PARTIAL. Substitute isolated-fixture verification (a scratch manifest/directory reproducing the exact scenario) for the blocked end-to-end check, and document the substitution's evidence inline.
